festEvents.title: ROBO-CLASH: Heavyweight Robowars
festEvents.tagline: Extreme Mechatronics Combat in 60kg Steel Cage
festEvents.arenaOrTrack: Reinforced 8mm Polycarbonate & Steel Arena with Pneumatic Hazards
festEvents.description: The crowning jewel of TECHTIX. Custom armor plates, high-tensile hardened S7 steel spinning drums, high-torque brushless drive systems, and pneumatic flippers clash in an enclosed bulletproof arena to determine the supreme combat machine.
rulesHighlights: Maximum weight cap: 60.0 kg (including weapon batteries)
Failsafe wireless RC cutoffs with high-current isolation link required
Active weapon mandatory (Spinning bar, vertical disc, pneumatic flipper, lifter)
3-minute match duration with active pit-fall trap at 90 seconds mark
specsRequirements: Dual optical & hardware RF link verification

festEvents.title: SPARK-ARENA: Featherweight 15kg
festEvents.tagline: High-RPM Vertical Spinners & Rapid Wedge Combat
festEvents.arenaOrTrack: Standard 4m x 4m Combat Ring with Pit Trap & Floor Grinders
festEvents.description: Lightning agility meets destructive impact. High-RPM spinning blades, invertible wedge bots, and pneumatic lifters battle at breakneck speed across high-hazard steel terrain.
rulesHighlights: Weight cap: 15.0 kg (+5% leeway for walking/shuffling mechanisms)
Single-fault dropouts: 10-second count out on total loss of mobility
Modular battery casing with flame-retardant silicone insulation
specsRequirements: Mechanical master switch easily accessible on rear hull
Weapon lock safety pins strictly enforced outside pit cage

festEvents.title: VELOCITY-LINE: High-Speed Autonomous LFR
festEvents.tagline: PID Micro-Controller Racing on High-Traction Hairpins
festEvents.arenaOrTrack: Modular 30mm White Line on Non-Reflective Black Matte Polymer with 90° Acute Hairpins, Inverted Loops, and Speed Gaps
festEvents.description: Ultra-fast optical sensor micro-mouse rovers navigating high-speed tracks with acute angled hairpins and dead-reckoning bridge hops.
rulesHighlights: Completely autonomous; zero teleoperation or wireless control during active run
Time penalized (+5s) for track skips or manual recalibrations
Micro-fans for downward vacuum downforce permitted
specsRequirements: Onboard optical array: minimum 8 phototransistors recommended

festEvents.title: NEURAL-BOT: 36H Hardware & Edge Vision Hackathon
festEvents.tagline: Continuous 36-Hour Autonomous ROS2 & Edge AI Prototyping
festEvents.arenaOrTrack: KGEC Mechatronics Prototyping Hub & Hardware Workbench Floor
festEvents.description: KGEC Robotics Society’s flagship hackathon where software meets steel. Teams build end-to-end edge robotics applications deploying computer vision, SLAM navigation, and real-time sensor processing.
rulesHighlights: All code repositories must be initiated at the opening sprint bell
Mandatory physical hardware prototype demonstration before the jury panel
Open-source libraries permitted with proper architecture disclosure
specsRequirements: Jetson Orin Nano, Raspberry Pi 5, or STM32 platforms supported
Benchtop 3D printing and SMD soldering stations provided
